title: Note required-member compiler support for library consumers
lead: `required` members need C# 11 (CS8936 at LangVersion 10); consumers on an older C# or on VB.NET cannot `new` ProfileOptions or FieldProfile (the compiler marks the constructor obsolete), though they can read members and use `ProfileOptions.Create`. The target is net10.0, so risk is low. Add one sentence to the user guide's library section.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Verify the claim with a scratch project on LangVersion 10 and VB; 2. add the sentence; 3. docs test if the guide has a pattern for it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
